standard_prerequisites.name: Local null-homotopy
standard_prerequisites.use: E^• → F^• → C(f)^• locally homotopic to zero.

core_obligations: The assumptions on f imply the cone C(f)^• has vanishing cohomology sheaves in degrees ≥ a (proof lines 11737-11740).

By the local-homotopy lemma the composition E^• → F^• → C(f)^• is homotopic to zero over the members of an open covering; since G^• → F^• → C(f)^• → G^•[1] restricts to a distinguished triangle, α|_{U_i} lifts up to homotopy to α_i : E^•|_{U_i} → G^•|_{U_i} (proof lines 11741-11752).
proof_roadmap: Vanish the cone in high degrees.
Null-homotope the composition locally and lift through the triangle.
difficulty_reason: The cone of f has vanishing cohomology sheaves in degrees ≥ a, so the composition into the cone is locally null-homotopic by the local-homotopy lemma, and the distinguished triangle then provides the lift.
